subject: Daz
fact: Daz is an elf with no known noble house affiliation, mysterious background, and sudden appearance prior to a high-value contract to extract him alive and unharmed. He possesses no overt signs of noble lineage but is the target of a contract orchestrated by House T'sarran.
source_quote: So then maybe there's more to me than meets the eye?

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is a High Priestess who built rituals around a fused sigil of Lolth and Zuggtmoy, indicating her devotion to two conflicting deities. She is now dead, her madness made physical in the stitched cloth found in the chamber.
source_quote: It was Ilvara's madness made physical — the thing she'd built her rituals around while she was becoming something that served two masters and understood neither.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym is an expressive, skeptical individual who questions Daz’s origins and dismisses the idea of hidden noble lineage as a common delusion among drow. She is irritated by the scale of the contract and the lack of transparency.
source_quote: That is an excellent question. You don't belong to any noble house, your background is a complete mystery, you suddenly show up, and all of a sudden, we're contracted to protect a nobody.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira is a professional, reserved investigator who analyzes evidence without speculation. She prioritizes facts over theory and acknowledges the limits of their mandate.
source_quote: Perhaps, but we're not paid to think that hard.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was the subject of a high-value contract by House T'sarran to extract him alive and unharmed, implicating him as a target of significant interest. His true identity remains unknown.
source_quote: There had been a contract. Extract Daz alive and unharmed. House T'sarran behind it.

subject: House T'sarran
fact: House T'sarran commissioned a contract to extract Daz alive and unharmed, using professional Drow mercenaries and routing the order through their network. They are a house with sufficient reach to make such a contract binding.
source_quote: There had been a contract. Extract Daz alive and unharmed. House T'sarran behind it.

subject: House Mizzrym
fact: House Mizzrym employed guards and a mage who were killed in the chamber. The mage carried a signet ring of House T'sarran, suggesting she was acting on their behalf despite her affiliation.
source_quote: The dead soldiers of House Mizzrym would never collect their pay.

subject: destruction of fungal corruption
fact: Grygum destroyed the pulsing fungal growth tied to Zuggtmoy’s influence using acid, reducing it to ash. The corruption had been slowly spreading up the stone platform and was actively radiating necromantic energy.
source_quote: He opened his mouth, and the acid came out clean and decisive, and the fungal matter that had spent months becoming something wrong collapsed into ash in the time it takes to exhale.

subject: discovery of the fused sigil
fact: A leather-wrapped bundle containing incense cones, a silver bowl, and a cloth stitched with the intertwined sigils of Lolth and Zuggtmoy was found. The cloth is evidence of Ilvara’s heretical rituals and her transformation into a servant of dual, conflicting deities.
source_quote: Inside: incense cones, a silver bowl small enough to fit in one hand, and a cloth that had been stitched with two sigils — Lolth's web worked into the eight-fold geometry of Zuggtmoy's mark, one woven inside the other.

subject: uncovering the contract documents
fact: Partially burned documents were recovered, confirming a contract issued by House T'sarran to extract Daz alive and unharmed. The documents were intentionally damaged but not fully destroyed, suggesting the destruction attempt failed due to the value of the information.
source_quote: They'd been partially burned, which meant someone had tried to destroy them and hadn't quite managed it, which meant the information in them was exactly the kind of thing worth knowing.

subject: T'sarran signet ring
fact: A signet ring bearing the unmistakable seal of House T'sarran was found on the dead mage. It serves as proof of her connection to the house and as a key to understanding the contract’s origin.
source_quote: I found the signet ring first — House T'sarran, the seal unmistakable on the face of it.

subject: obsidian wand with captive spider
fact: An obsidian wand with a spider preserved in amber at its tip was recovered from the mage. It is a magical artifact of unknown origin and function, possibly tied to her necromantic or arachnid-based rituals.
source_quote: Then the wand: obsidian, a captive spider preserved in amber at its tip.

subject: fused sigil cloth
fact: A cloth stitched with the intertwined sigils of Lolth and Zuggtmoy, one woven inside the other, was found in the bundle. It is not mere decoration — it is evidence of heretical ritual practice and the mage’s psychological collapse.
source_quote: It was Ilvara's madness made physical — the thing she'd built her rituals around while she was becoming something that served two masters and understood neither.

subject: Daz's true identity
fact: Daz’s origins are completely unknown. He has no noble lineage, no documented background, and yet he was the target of a high-stakes contract by a powerful house. His true identity and why he was targeted remain unresolved.
source_quote: You don't belong to any noble house, your background is a complete mystery, you suddenly show up...

subject: House T'sarran's motive
fact: The reason House T'sarran sought to extract Daz alive — rather than kill him — is unknown. Their motive, beyond the contract, and their connection to the mage and the chamber’s events, remain unexplained.
source_quote: Somebody had spent a significant amount of gold to ensure that the elf standing to my left made it out of this cavern breathing.

subject: Ilvara's dual devotion
fact: Ilvara’s fusion of Lolth and Zuggtmoy’s sigils suggests a heretical synthesis of two opposing deities. The implications of her transformation and whether she was acting alone or under external influence are unresolved.
source_quote: It was Ilvara's madness made physical — the thing she'd built her rituals around while she was becoming something that served two masters and understood neither.

subject: session date
fact: The events occurred during the current session, following the arrival of the mage with her mercenary escort and culminating in the discovery of the contract and artifacts.
source_quote: We'd been trying to piece together since the mage had arrived with her mercenary escort.
